cave_fog_stabilizer.config.stabilizeCave: Whether to stabilize fog when underground or not.
cave_fog_stabilizer.config.fogTransition: The time in seconds it takes to transition between surface and cave fog.
cave_fog_stabilizer.config.standardCaveF: The brightness of fog in caves which don't have a custom fog color. 0% is black.
cave_fog_stabilizer.config.customCaveFog: The brightness of fog in caves which have a custom fog color, relative to the brightness of the color itself. 100% shows the custom color as-is.
